messages:
morgan: Morning team — quick async standup focused on kernel/batching/KV perf. What I did / blockers / today. I'll drop mine first.

morgan: Did: landed the microbatch-algo change in staging (PR #492). Bench: 95th latency down ~12% on short seq (512) with continuous batching enabled. Also added a quick flag to force-disable compaction in the hotpath for repro.

morgan: Blockers: noticing occasional KV cache hot misses after the new eviction tweak; hit-rate drops from 98% -> ~89% on one trace. Trying to repro locally but env/setup differs.

morgan: Today: triage KV trace, add a small smoke that simulates warmup patterns, and follow up with Jas on canary tuning. If anyone has a recent trace from prod-canary (last 6h) pls ping.

jas: Nice win on 95th, congrats. I can share a trace — saw similar hit-rate dip on canary yesterday evening. Posting gist: https://rwd/g/kv-trace-171850 

jas: Did: ran a quick ablation toggling queue_size from 64 -> 48; microbatch packing improved tail for mixed-length requests.

jas: Blockers: still seeing a few OOMs in the <1% tail for long-chat workloads when prefetch is enabled + 8 concurrent sessions on a gpus. Not sure if it's kernel-side or allocator.

ravi: I'll take the repro for KV misses. Hypothesis: the eviction threshold calculation uses approximate timestamp that gets skewed when batch coalescing delays requests by >20ms. I'll instrument timestamps in the eviction path and rerun.

noah: Did: updated continuous batching feedback loop to weight older requests slightly higher to avoid starvation. Bench: throughput +4% for throughput-heavy workloads, latency stable.

noah: Blockers: need a small infra change to expose per-slot queue depth metrics to the dashboard before we can confirm the weighting is effective in prod.

sylvia: Quick note: deploy-bot triggered a canary yesterday at 03:12 UTC and rolled back once due to increased 503s. Logs point to a config mismatch between the runtime flags and the canary service. I pushed a hotfix to the canary config repo.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-04-05T03:12:11Z started (commit d4f2a3). Rollback at 03:19:02 due to 503 spike.

morgan: Thanks for the trace link Jas. Ravi — if you add the timestamp instrumentation, can you also output the batch-id in the log so we can correlate coalescing windows?

ravi: Yep — will include batch-id + slot-id. Plan: run on staging with the staging trace and share results by EOD.

jas: For the OOMs, can we try reducing per-request KV prefetch depth from 3 -> 2 as a quick mitigation? Should be a config change, not a code change. I'll open an ops ticket.

noah: Agree on adding the metric to dashboard. I can wire a prometheus exporter for per-slot queue depth by end of day if infra gives me access to the new metrics endpoint.

morgan: Quick ask: who can do a short review on PR #492? It's small but touches kernel hotpath. Prefer reviewers who've touched batching recently.

jas: I'll take a look in ~30m.

sylvia: FYI I scheduled a 15m sync at 16:00 UTC if folks want to go over traces together, otherwise we can keep this async.

morgan: Cool — I'll join. If anyone finds a repro or fresh trace, paste it here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
